description: Prune probe: framework Markov-trace MASS observables (fixed n) are NOT theta-shaped — their q-exponent supports are content/hook-based (dense, non-quadratic gaps), so direct Poisson/theta resummation does not apply. The theta self-duality (positive control) lives only in a quadratic-lattice sum. Bridge to root-of-unity requires reindexing the whole H_n(q) tower, not the fixed-n observable.
criterion: theta_compatible = (sorted exponent support has constant positive second difference, i.e. lies on {a n^2 + b n + c}); needs >= 4 points.
verdict: REFUTED for fixed-n mass observables; theta structure confined to the control (quadratic lattice). Poisson/theta bridge is NOT a fixed-n resummation.
